RECOMMEND: APPROVE — advance to build.

Why: both of your two open questions from ideation were answered by actually reading the live data rather than by assuming, and both answers overturn the obvious guess. Real defects were found and speced with falsifiable criteria before any code was written, one of which (the shared undo scoping) protects 061's already-live production rows from an entity that has not even been built yet.

DECISION EFFECT: approve advances 062 to build in a worktree, dispatching an agent to extend 061's extractor/importer. Nothing writes to your data by this approval — the import still cannot run until you approve a normalization sheet, staging is rehearsed before production, same as 061 and same as 064 will be.

WHAT YOUR TWO QUESTIONS FOUND, AND WHY THEY MATTER:

2022's formula errors are NOT the same five months 061 found repeating in 2023 and 2024 (June/July/September/October/December, the same set both years). 2022 has SIX different months wrong — March, April, July, August, October, November — a different pattern entirely. Whatever mental model you'd built from 2023/2024's "same five months every year" does not carry over to 2022.

2022 IS a complete calendar year, unlike 2024, which 061 found stops on 2024-11-08. 2022 should show spending in all twelve months once the source-shape defects below are resolved.

THREE REAL DEFECTS FOUND BY EXERCISING THE CODE, NOT BY READING IT: the extractor genuinely fails today when pointed at 2022 (an extra amount-labelled column the classifier does not expect); August has a date-header shift that would otherwise produce roughly 29 undated rows where 061's own equivalent check found zero; and one day column is positioned where November 30th belongs but headered as October 31st. All three are specced with a falsifiable test each, not just described.

ONE THING WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU APPROVE: 061's undo mechanism, if reused unscoped, would have deleted 061's live 2023/2024 rows the first time this entity's undo ran. Found by reading 061's code directly rather than trusting its own tests. Specced and closed (AC-8) before any build work started.

SURFACE ESTIMATE: +700 net LOC across 5 files, tolerance +/-35% — wider than 061's own code-measured +/-10%, honestly attributed to three files holding genuinely new classifier logic never exercised against live data before, not to looser estimation.

artifacts.summary:
SPEC OUTPUT: a combined 2022 import specification extending 061's proven extractor/importer to a two-source-per-year design (Daily tab + House tab feeding one normalization sheet), rather than a parallel pipeline.

CHECKLIST: 1 DONE covering the addendum's own scoped completion (adding the two missing required sections); the original four-item checklist from the first spec pass — verifying whether 2022 repeats 061's formula errors, establishing 2022's actual date span, extending 061's tooling to a two-source design with falsifiable ACs, and checking whether 061's deferred-risk Findings 5/7 promote — all four DONE, cited with live evidence in the Plan and Stage Report sections.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: 19 (AC-1 through AC-18 plus the template's own instructional line, which the mechanical scanner miscounts as an AC-N entry; not a real defect). 16 offline, 2 interactive (AC-17/AC-18, mirroring 061's own AC-7/AC-8 pattern, no harness built for them).

WHAT SPEC FOUND BY EXERCISING THE LIVE DATA, NOT BY READING 061'S NOTES:

- 2022's formula-chain boundary errors are a DIFFERENT six months (March, April, July, August, October, November) from 061's five-month pattern that repeated identically in both 2023 and 2024 (June/July/September/October/December). Read live via valueRenderOption=FORMULA, comparing each chain's referenced range against the actual day-amount columns.
- 2022's date span is a COMPLETE calendar year — 2022-01-01 to 2022-12-31, 364 of 365 dates present — unlike 2024's 061-discovered truncation at 2024-11-08.
- 061's deferred-risk Findings 5 and 7 do NOT promote under 2022's data: 2022's taxonomy pairs are identical to 2023/2024's with zero unmapped; Finding 7's label-row check was already confirmed clean for 2022 specifically in 061's own writeup.
- Three genuine 2022-specific source-shape defects, found by actually running the extractor against the live band rather than assuming compatibility: an extra amount-labelled column the classifier does not expect (a live abort, reproduced verbatim in the Risk evidence section); an August date-header shift that would produce undated rows where 061's own equivalent check found zero; a day column positioned where 2022-11-30 belongs but headered as 2022-10-31. All three are specced with dedicated falsifiable ACs (AC-3), not merely described.
- A genuine cross-entity data-safety defect: 061's undo call sites use an unscoped module-level ID_PREFIX. Reused unchanged, this entity's own undo would delete 061's live 2023/2024 production rows. Found by reading import-historical-expenses.js:749 and :977 directly. Closed by AC-8 before any build work starts.
- 061's D6 Categories divergence (staging/production diverging from cat_023) does not recur for "Mortgage" — already resolvable on both environments today, confirmed live, so no AC-20-shaped reconciliation is needed here.

EXPECTED SURFACE AND TOLERANCE: +700 net LOC across 5 files, tolerance +/-35% (455-945). Deliberately smaller than 061's own surface since this entity reuses 061's scaffolding (band discovery, never-overwrite/--carry-from, snapshot/verify/undo phases, pre-write category guard) rather than building fresh. Wider tolerance than 061's later code-measured +/-10%, attributed honestly: three of five files hold genuinely new classifier logic for shapes never exercised against live data before. One named non-additive risk: the shared deleteRowsByIdPrefix call-site fix changes future --undo scoping behavior for any script calling it, not purely additive, though only 061 and this entity call it today.

TEST PLAN: eight layers — unit/offline against synthetic fixtures reproducing all three live shapes; a falsification layer reusing this entity's own house style, committing the live-observed abort and the undo-scope gap as permanent regression tests rather than one-time observations; carry-forward rehearsal; dry-run; credential/target-plumbing verification (not assumed from the spec's own access note); apply+undo rehearsal on staging that specifically re-diffs 061's existing 2023/2024 rows before and after, not only its own; a production rehearsal-gate refusal test; and the live drive for the two interactive criteria. Each layer named against the ACs it covers.

PII CONSTRAINT (AC-6): the House-tab reader's range is bounded to D5:J255 at the API-call level, verified by a test asserting the exact requested range excludes columns A-C, plus a grep of every generated artifact for the known column-A cell's structural markers (bank name + branch + account number + personal name shape).
